Not a fan of that pistol setup or the plate carrier setup in general.
why, out of curiosity. I know why the pistol carrier, no one likes that but me, but the rest of the carrier in general.

That pistol holster really is what triggers me the hardest. That particular holster itself is junk, and chest mounting is really a last resort place to put a pistol that you don’t seem to need.

You seem to have cash so I’ll say that if you are committed to chest mounting a holster at the least upgrade it. Safariland has MOLLE adaptor mounts which you can adjust at an angle. This means you could put a proper thumb push fitted holster at closer to a 45 degree downward angle than your current 90 degree to the side for better ergo. You can also quick detach the holster from the adaptor, allowing you to switch between chest and belt mounts which might push you towards trying a belt mount.

Next thing is that massive pouch that I’m assuming is a first aid kit. I’d love to get a look inside that fatboi. If you want to keep a kit where either hand can reach, a Velcro dangle pouch hanging down your center will free up all that space under your arms.

By moving the large IFAK off the cummerbund, you now have room to single rather than double stack your mags.

Fair enough.

The holster is a cheapo, correct, with some modifications. The only reason I have it as a chest rig is that is sits next to my bed to be thrown on quickly. I don't want to deal with a drop holster for that, but I do have one for the field. I just didn't feel like dragging it out of my pack. Though if you do have any suggestions on a swivel clip drop leg holster that will fit a sig 1911 tacops with rail mounted attachments, I'm all ears. I currently have to take off my laser and light when I go from the fits anything condor holster, to the serpa leg holster.

The ifak looks large because the mag pouches have nothing in them. Its slightly smaller than the standard issue military pouch, but with a lot more in it, more along the lines of a small combat lifesaver bag. It mounts to the molle through an hdpe plate faced with velcro which the bag sticks to and then it buckled into place. I designed it like that mostly because I can take it off quickly and toss it to someone else or throw it in the car. While yeah, everyone should have their own -individual-fak, the reality is that if I ever had to earnestly use this shit, I'll probably be one of the few that does. I actually prefer it in that location because I can rest my elbow on it when my weapon has to stay in a high ready for a long time, and my forearm on it when I'm in a low carry. Lazy, I know, but that scar gets heavy and I picked up bad habits carrying a saw.

As far as double stacks, its mostly a single stack that wraps around. The center double stack is for the shorter 20rd mags with specialty rounds, so I can keep them separate from the regular ball ammo. They could really go anywhere, I just keep them there in the interest of weight distribution.

I'll see if I can remember to take pics of the inside of the bag tonight.
